pages.text: Shops sell and buy for $(l)Shatter Pieces$() (some lots ask for Shatter Coins instead). You find them at a $(item)Vendor Post$(), at a stall, or at an NPC in the world: right-click to see the shelves.$(br2)Each card shows the lot, $(l)buy$() and $(l)sell$() prices and the stock left. Left click buys, right click sells, shift and right click sells every full lot you hold.

$(l)Sell here$() opens a tray: drop items in and close it; every full lot the shop buys is paid for in one go and the rest comes back.$(br2)Some shops keep $(l)opening hours$(). A closed vendor shows when it opens and how long is left. A vendor's post powers the block beneath it while the shop is open, so signs and lamps can follow.$(br2)A $(item)Stall Display$() beside a vendor floats its wares in the air, one after another, while the shop is open. Right-click it to open the shop.
pages.title: Selling and hours

pages.text: A $(item)Market Stall$() is a shop front in one of eight styles: a timber booth, a vending terminal, a boiler booth, a player-built stall, a blackstone shrine, a street cart, a dockside stall or a mage's pedestal. Right-click it for its shop.$(br2)Two lamps tell you the state before you click: the left one is $(l)green$() while the shop has stock and $(l)red$() when it is sold out, the right one $(l)amber$() while the shop is open. The shop's first item sits on the counter. A stall with no shop stands broken and out of order.
pages.title: Market Stalls

pages.text: Buy the $(l)Shopping Network$() on your $(item)Portable Banker$() with Shatter Coins and the shops marked remote open from anywhere. It stays with your account, whatever happens to the device; admins may clear it at a season end.$(br2)Special offers show a chip with the discount; rotating shops change their shelves on a timer.
pages.title: The Shopping Network
